Sub Bump(x, ByVal y)
    x = x + 10
    y = y + 10
End Sub
Function Main()
    Dim a As Long, b As Long, c As Long
    a = 1: b = 2: c = 3
    Bump a, b
    Bump (c), b
    Main = a & "," & b & "," & c
End Function

Function Combine(a As Long, Optional b As Long = 5, Optional c) As String
    Combine = a & ":" & b & ":" & IsMissing(c)
End Function
Function SumAll(ParamArray vals() As Variant) As Long
    Dim i As Long, t As Long
    For i = LBound(vals) To UBound(vals)
        t = t + vals(i)
    Next i
    SumAll = t
End Function
Function Main()
    Main = Combine(10) & "|" & Combine(b:=20, a:=1, c:=9) & "|" & SumAll(1, 2, 3, 4)
End Function

Option Base 1
Function Main()
    Dim a() As Long
    ReDim a(1 To 2, 1 To 2)
    a(1, 1) = 10: a(2, 2) = 40
    ReDim Preserve a(1 To 2, 1 To 3)
    a(2, 3) = 50
    Main = LBound(a, 1) & "," & UBound(a, 2) & "," & a(2, 2) & "," & a(2, 3)
End Function

Enum Kind
    First = 1
    Second
End Enum
Type Pair
    X As Byte
    Y As Long
End Type
Function Main()
    Dim p As Pair, q As Pair
    p.X = 2.5
    p.Y = Kind.Second
    q = p
    q.X = 9
    Main = p.X & "," & p.Y & "," & q.X
End Function

Option Compare Text
Function Main()
    Main = ("Hello" = "hello") & "," & ("AbC12" Like "abc##") & "," & ("z" Like "[!0-9]")
End Function

Function Main()
    Dim d As Long, r As Long
    d = 0
    On Error GoTo Fix
    r = 10 / d
    Main = r
    Exit Function
Fix:
    d = 2
    Resume
End Function

Function Main()
    Dim d As Date
    d = DateAdd("m", 1, DateSerial(2024, 1, 31))
    Main = Format(d, "yyyy-mm-dd") & "|" & Round(SLN(10000, 1000, 9), 0) & "|" & Join(Split("a,b,c", ","), "-")
End Function

Function Main()
    Dim c As New Collection
    c.Add "one", "k1"
    Dim d As Object
    Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    d("a") = 42
    Dim re As Object
    Set re = CreateObject("VBScript.RegExp")
    re.Pattern = "\d+"
    re.Global = True
    Main = c("K1") & "|" & d("a") & "|" & re.Replace("x12y34", "#")
End Function
